svg.title: Square-to-round mouthpiece, trumpet layout - 30 rings, 10mm square bore to 3.66mm throat to ø17mm lip
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Station one is a sharp 10mm square aperture in a sharp 16mm square plate, matching the bore corner for corner. The corners round away going up and the section is a true circle from the 9.02618mm station on, so the 3.66mm throat and the whole cup are round. The trumpet layout: 26 backbore rings, 0 entrance rings, then 4 bowl rings to a ø17mm rim. Wall 3 to 4.96mm, 3mm of rise a ring, stack 90mm. Every joint seats on at least 1.00mm per side, flats and corners alike. Rings stack; they do not telescope.
